extension.summary: Native Usenet reader for Lucent Video (test)
extension.description: Reads Usenet releases for Lucent Video in C++, without the local web server and without Python in the data path. Based on vfs.tmdbm by Angelitto (GPL-2.0-or-later).
Leest Usenet-releases voor Lucent Video in C++, zonder de lokale webserver en zonder Python ertussen. Gebaseerd op vfs.tmdbm van Angelitto (GPL-2.0-or-later).
extension.news: 0.1.5: an article the player needs is never left waiting when it was first asked for by an extra reader or as a skip target (possible freeze). 0.1.4: skip targets on the film's own key frames (from the Matroska index) and kept until they are used; chapter pictures wait while the player needs the line; fewer articles fetched twice. 0.1.3: skips forward start at once (the spots 30 s, 1 min and 10 min ahead are made ready); tells Lucent Video when a film cannot be read any further, so it continues with another source at the same moment. 0.1.2: counts per provider for Lucent Video's statistics screen (data, speed, latency, missing articles, errors). 0.1.1: own icon (blue, with a lightning bolt). 0.1.0: first release: native Usenet reader for Lucent Video, faster seeking.
